card.text: A Cepheid in the Milky Way, 61 times the Sun's width, that swells and shrinks every 8.0 days.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
sources.locator: table10, DL Cas: Per, Rad, Dist

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 60.7 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 1,845 parsecs away.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
sources.locator: table10, DL Cas: Per, Rad, Dist
